name: Marketing operations
description: Research -> draft content -> fact/brand review -> publishing approval. Produces approved campaign artifacts; never sends unsolicited outreach automatically.

steps.title: Research for {{campaign}}
steps.instructions: Gather facts for {{campaign}} with sources. Do not contact anyone.

steps.title: Draft content for {{campaign}}
steps.acceptance: Drafts use only facts from the fact sheet.
steps.instructions: Draft the content for {{campaign}} using the fact sheet.

steps.title: Fact and brand review for {{campaign}}
steps.instructions: Review {{campaign}} drafts for factual accuracy and brand fit.

steps.title: Publishing approval for {{campaign}}
steps.acceptance: Human approval recorded; no automatic publishing or outreach.
steps.instructions: Approve or deny publishing of {{campaign}}. Publishing and outreach are manual actions after approval.
